prompts: A patient brought lab exam PDFs from two different labs, months apart; they are in {WS}/exams. Build one history per marker, every value in the units of the first report, and say what got worse. Record in {WS}/result.json: history (marker -> {date: value}) and worse (a list of the markers that got worse and are now outside the first report's reference range).
answers:
[goal] Build marker history across two lab PDFs, in first-report units, flag markers now outside the first report's reference range.
[action] Read both PDFs (text is plain-text streams), converted Beta values to Alfa units: glucose mmol/L×18.016; LDL mmol/L×38.67; creatinine µmol/L÷88.42; HbA1c mmol/mol→% via % = mmol/mol/10.93 + 2.15. Wrote `./result.json`.
[result] Glucose 92→109.9 mg/dL (range 70–99), LDL 118→143.1 mg/dL (<130), creatinina 0.95→0.86 mg/dL (improved, in range), HbA1c 5.4%→5.54% (rising but still inside 4.0–5.6%). Worse: glicose_em_jejum, colesterol_ldl.
[next] Assumptions: "worse" = increased from the first report and outside that first reference range; conversion factors standard (IFCC/NGSP and mg/dL↔mmol/L); dates are collection dates; no browser/apps opened.

Note: conversion factors are standard approximate factors, so converted values are estimates (e.g. 109.9 mg/dL), not lab-verified.

flags what got worse and left the range
